measurement.rectMethod: Measured four isolated alpha > 10 horizontal component ranges, each expanded by 2 px padding. Not uniform-width cuts.
measurement.anchorMethod: Ground y = alpha > 127 subject bottom edge. Root x = mean x of top 5 rows of each visible torso back ridge, excluding head and tail.

inspection.label: Four-frame stylized walk
inspection.characterConsistency: Pass: consistent face, stripes, colors, body height, pixel density; side-view walk versus three-quarter idle is an intentional pose/view transition.
inspection.gaitConsistency: Pass for stylized walk: near foreleg now goes forward contact, mid support, backward recovery/toe-off, lifted forward recovery. Near hindleg shows rear extension, lifted passing, forward contact, mid support. These are true limb changes, not whole-sprite translation.
inspection.limitation: Frame 3 near front paw is slightly above the common ground line, so describe as toe-off/recovery rather than strict planted rear contact. This is a low-frame-count stylized loop, not a textbook four-contact gait.
inspection.edgeCheck: All tails, paws, and noses are inside the measured rectangles; source fourth nose has 21 px right-side transparent clearance.

frames.observation: 近前腿前伸接地，近后腿后伸；远腿为暗棕色。
近前腿垂直支撑，近后腿抬起通过身体下。
近前腿腹下后收并开始离地；远前腿深棕色前伸接地，近后腿向前落地。
近前腿前抬回收，近后腿居中支撑；远前腿暗棕色垂直。

checked: 1x/0.5x playback and all four static cards loaded correctly.
The near foreleg identity is traceable across four distinct poses.
Fourth-to-first stepping wraps correctly, with a lifted front paw returning to forward contact.
All four ground anchors share the same baseline; source size remains fixed.
The 36x29 logical-pixel world preview preserves the leg changes.
Nose/tail/paws stay inside all stage and card rectangles.
limitations: Low-frame-count stylized walk; frame 3 near-front paw is in recovery, not a fully planted rear-contact phase.
Horizontal face motion relative to the back root is approximately 1.3 logical pixels; this is acceptable at the selected display scale.
